Step 8 Five-class Soft-label Single-channel Benchmark

Soft-label stage only. Input resolution is fixed at 384 x 384. Task: original CEA 0-4 five-class. Soft labels are dynamically generated from original hard labels: interior classes use 0.90 for the true class and 0.05 for each adjacent class; boundary classes use 0.90 and 0.10. ResNet50 ImageNet pretrained; AdamW lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4; batch 16; 50 epochs; no validation, scheduler, or early stopping. Seeds: 42, 3407, 2026.
